name: Reload shortens Quickdraw's cooldown by 4 seconds (#3359)
contract: Reload 804190 reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Quickdraw by $/1000;s1 sec.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 21, with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -4001 (DieSides 1, so -4000 ms), class mask word 0 = 0x40. Quickdraw ranks 804193 and 806846 have family 21, flag word 0 0x40 and RecoveryTime = CategoryRecoveryTime = 10000 ms. Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both times (Player.cpp:11451-11456), and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no family-21 override, so plain class-mask matching decides. The cooldown becomes 6000 ms. The scenario reads it with the spell_modifier probe on both ranks and on Heartseeking Bolt 805754 (flag word 0 is 0) as the control; it does not cast Quickdraw because the spell is gated behind a critical-strike aura and a ranged weapon that add nothing to this contract.
